prd.title: Combined Unimplemented Features
prd.target: All remaining unimplemented features consolidated into one PRD

executive_summary: This PRD consolidates all unimplemented features from 9 separate PRD files, excluding features that conflict with the summary-driven character profiling approach (Option B). Features from character-profiling-enhancements-v2 (F1-F5) form the core, with compatible features from other PRDs organized into phases.

excluded_features.reason: Conflict with Option B (summary-driven approach) or already implemented

list.reason: Conflicts with v2 F1 summary-driven merge

list.feature: F7: Character Proof from Entire Narrative

features.name: Summary-Driven Character Merge
features.description: Parse book summary for explicit identity statements ('A is later known as B') and force-merge those characters regardless of distribution patterns
features.rationale: Book summary already correctly identifies 'Cathy Ames—later revealed to be the cruel brothel madam Kate'. This is the most reliable merge source.

features.name: Summary-Derived Profile Evidence
features.description: Extract character-specific statements from chapter summaries and include as PRIMARY evidence in profile generation, ranked above raw text mentions
features.rationale: Summaries know Kate poisoned Faye, but profile says 'manages household affairs'. Summary evidence must flow to profiles.

features.name: Moral Valence Propagation to Profiles
features.description: Pass moral valence classification to profile generator as HARD CONSTRAINT. ANTAGONIST classification prevents positive descriptors.
features.rationale: Kate classified as ANTAGONIST but profile describes her as 'effective, composed'. Classification must constrain generation.

features.name: Relaxed Disjoint Distribution Heuristic
features.description: Use 80% dominant chapter ranges instead of strict separation. Catches cases where character is discussed by old name in later chapters.
features.rationale: Cathy appears in later chapters when discussed, breaking strict disjoint check. Dominant range approach handles this.

features.name: Chapter Tag Identity Propagation
features.description: Parse chapter tags for compound names (A/B format like 'Cathy/Kate') and use as merge signals
features.rationale: Chapter 24 already has 'Cathy/Kate' tag but this signal is ignored. Should trigger merge consideration.

features.name: Passage-Based Profile Generation
features.description: Search full text for character-relevant passages, generate comprehensive profiles with appearance, personality, voice guidance, and relationships
features.rationale: Current profiles from 10 sampled mentions with 200-char windows. Need full passages for rich narrator-useful profiles.

features.name: Character Reconciliation Safety Net
features.description: Final LLM-based check after profile generation to catch any remaining duplicate characters
features.rationale: Even with summary-driven identification, edge cases may slip through. Safety net for final cleanup.

features.name: Simplified Character Output
features.description: Reorganize character output to prioritize narrator-useful info (appearance, personality, voice) over metrics (mention counts, positions)
features.rationale: Narrators need voice guidance, not mention counts. Output structure should reflect actual needs.

features.name: TOC Entry Validation
features.description: Fix TOC parsing to correctly count entries, filter metadata lines, validate against Roman numeral/Chapter N patterns
features.rationale: Gatsby detected as 16 chapters instead of 9. TOC parser reports 'expects 91' instead of 9.

features.name: Explicit Marker Anchoring
features.description: Treat explicit chapter markers (centered Roman numerals, 'CHAPTER N') as hard boundaries that dominate over soft signals
features.rationale: Explicit headings exist but get overridden by narrative-only guesses, causing over-splitting.

features.name: Back Matter Detection and Exclusion
features.description: Detect boilerplate/license/metadata blocks and exclude from chapter detection, summaries, and character extraction
features.rationale: Project Gutenberg license appeared in chapter summary, produced spurious characters like 'Professor Michael S. Hart'.

features.name: Longer and More Accurate Chapter Summaries
features.description: Increase summary length to 3-5 sentences, prioritize factual accuracy over brevity, include context for referenced incidents
features.rationale: Brief summaries cause errors (characters walking when in a car, unexplained 'pearls' reference). Feeds character profiling pipeline.

features.name: Name Normalization
features.description: Normalize character names: remove quotes, trailing punctuation, unicode apostrophe variants, possessive suffixes
features.rationale: Punctuation variants ('Daisy!', 'Daisy?') becoming aliases. Names need cleaning before matching.

features.name: Fail-Fast Error Handling
features.description: Replace silent failures with clear error messages. Remove hardcoded fallback confidence values (0.5, 0.7) that mask bugs.
features.rationale: Validation errors caught and masked with fallbacks hide real bugs. Fail-fast is better than fail-silent.

features.name: Frequency-Based Canonical Names
features.description: Use mention counts to select canonical name, not alphabetical order. Most-mentioned form becomes canonical.
features.rationale: Alphabetical tiebreaker causes less-frequently-used names to become canonical.

features.name: Confidence Scoring Improvements
features.description: High-mention characters should get high confidence scores. Remove fallbacks that ignore mention count.
features.rationale: Characters with 300+ mentions incorrectly marked low confidence due to averaged fallback values.

features.name: Model Health Checks
features.description: Detect and exclude models that return empty responses before analysis begins
features.rationale: Broken models waste time and cause failures. Should be detected during initialization.

features.name: Performance Optimization
features.description: Analysis should complete in under 60 minutes for typical novel. Profile and optimize slow phases.
features.rationale: Analysis currently takes 2+ hours due to redundant processing.

features.name: Character Profile Hallucination Prevention
features.description: Profile claims must be grounded in actual text. Each statement links to source evidence. Entity disambiguation prevents name/location conflation.
features.rationale: 'Mrs. Claud Roosevelt' conflated casual reference with location, then invented fictional backstory.

features.name: Evidence-Linked Character Profiles
features.description: Profile shows clickable evidence citations [1], [2], [3]. Clicking expands to show source passage.
features.rationale: Character profiles are prose blobs with no source attribution. Evidence builds narrator trust.

features.name: Tabbed HTML Interface
features.description: Replace scroll-based navigation with tabs: Overview | Chapters | Characters | Pronunciations. URL hash for deep linking.
features.rationale: HTML report is one long scroller, hard to navigate for narrators.

features.name: Per-Chapter Pronunciation Guide
features.description: Add 'By Chapter' view alongside 'By Type'. Shows expandable sections per chapter with pronunciation count.
features.rationale: 470-item pronunciation list. Narrators need per-chapter lists for preparation.

features.name: Confidence Indicators in HTML
features.description: Visual confidence badges (green/yellow/red). Hover shows percentage. Filter to show only low-confidence items.
features.rationale: Low-confidence items not visually distinguished in HTML report.

features.name: Searchable Pronunciation List
features.description: Search box filters pronunciation list in real-time by word, IPA, or flag reason. Shows 'X of Y items' count.
features.rationale: Large pronunciation lists (400+ items) hard to search.

features.name: Analysis Overview Page
features.description: High-level book structure explanation, 3-5 paragraph plot summary, model usage table, timing breakdown per phase
features.rationale: No overview exists. Users must piece together information from various outputs.

features.name: Paragraph Indexing
features.description: Extend WordIndex to detect and store paragraph boundaries during initial scan
features.rationale: Foundation for paragraph-based context system. Single-pass detection.

features.name: Paragraph-Based Context Extraction
features.description: Replace fixed-window context (100 chars) with full paragraph extraction
features.rationale: 100-character windows truncate mid-sentence. Full paragraphs provide complete context.

features.name: GUI Clickable Words
features.description: Click pronunciation word to see full paragraph with word highlighted. Navigate between occurrences.
features.rationale: Core UX improvement for narrator pronunciation review workflow.

features.name: Full Text Navigation
features.description: Jump to word position in full document from pronunciation dialog
features.rationale: Allows narrators to see broader context beyond paragraph.

features.name: HTML Export with Paragraph Context
features.description: Interactive HTML pronunciation export with full paragraphs, highlighted words, position info
features.rationale: Enables offline review and sharing of pronunciation guide.

phase_1.name: Summary-Driven Character Profiling
phase_1.description: Core character profiling pipeline improvements. Ensures summarized understanding flows to profiles.

phase_2.name: Chapter Detection & Content Quality
phase_2.description: Fix chapter detection issues and improve summary quality that feeds profiling.

phase_3.name: Error Handling & Reliability
phase_3.description: Fail-fast errors, correct canonical names, model health checks, performance.

phase_4.name: HTML/Output Quality
phase_4.description: HTML UX improvements, evidence linking, tabbed interface, overview page.

phase_5.name: Pronunciation Phase 2
phase_5.description: Paragraph-based context system for pronunciation guide.

secondary_tests: Gatsby: exactly 9 chapters with Roman numeral titles
Gatsby: no Project Gutenberg characters in output
